summary: The buffered timeout is removed from DeepSeek streaming dispatch, and a focused regression test covers a producing stream that outlives it.

evidence: src/deepseek/handlers.ts:441 uses the downstream signal for streamed requests instead of the fixed buffered inference signal, leaving stream timeout handling to the stream reader.
tests/openai-compat-part10.test.ts:474-503 verifies that a stream producing a second frame after the simulated buffered deadline still completes successfully.
